---
name: 'review-rainfocus-accessibility'
description: 'Review or fix a RainFocus component or experience against WCAG 2.2 and WAI-ARIA APG with keyboard, focus, semantics, responsive, and regression evidence.'
argument-hint: '<review only or review and fix; component or workflow; observed concern; target conformance; affected states>'
agent: 'rainfocus-accessibility-reviewer'
---

Review the accessibility of the component or experience provided with this prompt.

Preserve whether the request is **review only** or **review and fix**. Establish the rendered behavior and scope before selecting an ARIA pattern or WCAG criteria. Test the relevant states, keyboard and focus behavior, semantics, visual presentation, and existing regressions; keep fixes within the supplied scope and report evidence, standards sources, unverified checks, and disposition as required by the selected agent.
